title: Petal Flower Studs
descriptionHtml:
A small flower, cut to catch light. Each stud is a four petal bloom: three round clear cubic zirconia around a polished metal centre, and one larger pear cut stone falling below like a petal caught mid-drop. All claw set, on a straight post with a butterfly back, so it sits flat and close to the lobe.

STYLING TIP: Wear them every day, or as a second piercing beside a small hoop.

Details

  • Size: Approximately 13mm tall
  • Stones: Three round clear cubic zirconia, approximately 4mm, and one pear cut stone below
  • Centre: Polished metal disc
  • Closure: Post with butterfly back
  • Plating: 18k gold tone plated or rhodium plated silver tone (choose above)
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
